text:
alex: Quick check — we need a short bridge call tomorrow 09:00 PT to align Marketplace listing (CloudMart), EdgeMatrix hardware partner onboarding, and the press/embargo plan. Who can join?

maria: I can make 09:00 PT. Is this the final embargo window decision or a sync to lock assets? :wave:

kevin: I’ll join. EdgeMatrix still needs final test images from infra and the SI runbook signoff. Status: infra tests passing, awaiting docs.

sasha: Landing page heads-up — creative has 2 hero variants ready, but we need final copy from press ops and the CTA link for catalog flows.

lina: Localization timeline — we can do en + fr + de for launch if copy is final by EOD today. Anything else needed for translatable strings?

press_ops: Proposed embargo window: 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC. Press release draft v3 in Google Drive: https://docs.google.com/example/dr-v3. Need final quotes from partners by 12:00 PT tomorrow.

alex: Thanks — items to cover on the bridge: 1) embargo window confirmation (press_ops) 2) EdgeMatrix SI onboarding checklist + test image delivery (kevin) 3) landing page hero + CTA + tracking params (sasha) 4) localization cutover (lina) 5) marketplace tile metadata and pricing (maria) 6) bridge owner & oncall for launch day (alex).

kevin: SI onboarding quick status: EdgeMatrix team completed hardware validation. Outstanding: upload of quantized model artifacts to S3 (artifact path), and a short runbook for partners that covers CUDA/driver matrix. I can drop runbook link in thread during call.

alex: @kevin please paste the runbook link in thread before the call. Also confirm who at EdgeMatrix will be on the launch day oncall.

kevin: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/edgematrix-si. Oncall: @edge-lead (TBD) but I’ll confirm by noon.

maria: Marketplace tile metadata: draft in Confluence -> /marketplace/cloudmart/edgematrix-tile. Pricing needs final sign-off from finance (cc: @lina-finance?). If we want promo credit, shout now.

lina: Localization: I need the final copy file (strings.csv) and the hero alt text. If we get that by EOD, translations finish tomorrow morning and QA in the afternoon.

press_ops: Quick ask — partner quote templates below. Please paste an approved quote or a one-liner we can adapt by 12:00 PT. Also confirm press embargo contact for each partner.

alex: For bridge tomorrow, I’ll run a 20m stand, owners should have answers ready. Agenda + dial-in: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: market). Please RSVP in thread.

maria: RSVP — yes. I’ll bring marketplace metadata and pricing options.

sasha: RSVP — yes. Will bring final hero art and tracking snippets. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/marketplace-hero

kevin: RSVP — yes. Will confirm EdgeMatrix oncall and post runbook updates.

lina: RSVP — yes. Will post strings.csv link in thread after copy review.

press_ops: RSVP — yes, and I’ll bring embargo window confirmation and the press release v3 link.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-staging -> prod cutover window 2025-06-18T15:30:00Z. Automated smoke tests set. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

alex: Perfect. Pre-call prep checklist (paste if helpful):
```
- Confirm embargo time and contacts
- Partner quotes approved (press_ops)
- Artifact upload + SI runbook posted (kevin)
- Landing hero + CTA + tracking (sasha)
- Strings.csv + l10n signoff (lina)
- Marketplace metadata & pricing (maria)
- Launch day oncall rota (kevin/alex)
```

alex: If anyone has blockers that can’t be resolved before 12:00 PT, ping me directly. Otherwise see you on the bridge. :rocket:
